error.LastCopy: Nothing moved: no copy would be left outside the system folders, or the copies are the same file.

reason.nodeModules: Project dependencies (node_modules) — install them again with the package manager

reason.discordCache: Discord cache — your favorite GIFs will be gone

reason.lockFile: Can be restored: a lock file is next to it

cleanup.info.hiberfil: {path} ({size}) is the hibernation file. To remove it, run powercfg /h off as administrator.
cleanup.info.previousWindows: {path} ({size}) holds the previous Windows. Remove it in Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
cleanup.info.windowsUpdate: {path} ({size}) holds downloaded Windows updates. Remove them in Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
cleanup.info.deliveryOptimization: {path} ({size}) is the Delivery Optimization cache. Remove it in Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
cleanup.info.toolStore: {path} ({size}) is shared with your projects, so SizeAtlas leaves it alone. The tool cleans it safely:
cleanup.info.noAccess: {path} needs administrator rights to be read.
